metaDescription: Audite is a daily listening of the Bible, from beginning to end. What cannot be heard yet is in preparation.
homeTitle: The Bible, from beginning to end.
homeLede: Audite is a way to listen to Scripture each day, along a path through the books. It is not a game or a social network.
dailyBody: The idea is to return to the stretch where you left off. Listening is in preparation.
pathBody: The journey runs from the beginning of the Bible toward the end. Each book is waiting for its audio. Nothing is presented as if it could already be heard.
comingSoonBody: This language does not have text for this episode yet.
episodeDescription: An episode of Audite. What is not ready yet stays in preparation.
catalogIntro: An episode can be heard only when its audio is ready. Everything else is in preparation, or in review when it needs another look.
membershipBody: Audite is meant to be heard with a membership. On this site the membership is in preparation.
noPrice: There is no payment and there are no sample accounts.
